column1: # The units of Layer Bc (scripts/c11-lane.sh) that do not compile, each with the first
# error its compile gives, as <header><TAB><words>, without path or position.
# Columns: unit, header, the error's words, why.
# A unit named here and refused with these words is not a failure. A unit named here
# that compiles, or that is refused with other words, is: the row is removed or
# corrected in the commit that changes it, so the table only shrinks by the fix it
# waits for, and a second fault cannot hide behind the first.
# Every row below waits for one defect of SCE's C11 generator, found by this lane at the
# pin it was written with (vendor/sce e90c0b6271b): a codec document that imports
# another codec under an alias other than the imported codec's own name (wz's documents
# import ext_unit.scxml as codec_zenoh_ext_unit, the name SCE's fixture of it has) is
# emitted with the imported type named by the name (ext_unit_t) and its decode called
# by the alias (codec_zenoh_ext_unit_decode), which no header declares. The Rust
# emission of the same documents resolves the alias. A unit is listed when its header
# includes one such codec, itself or through what it imports.
